prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in West Palm Beach FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Luxury Property Care (LPC)** looks like a strong option to interview: its listing reports a **4.9/5 rating from more than 230 Google reviews** and describes full-service management for single-family homes, including tenant screening, leasing, rent collection, maintenance, inspections, and evictions. It lists management fees of **8–10% of collected rent** and a leasing fee of **one month’s rent**. [LPC](https://luxurypropertycare.com/west-palm-beach-property-management-services/)

I’d compare it with **Florida’s Property Management**, which advertises Palm Beach County coverage, single-family home management, and no cancellation fee or maintenance markup. Ask for its complete fee schedule, since the advertised monthly price may depend on rent and property type. [Florida’s Property Management](https://www.floridaspropertymanagement.com/)

Before choosing, get written answers about the total fees, repair-approval limits, inspection frequency, lease-up process, and how quickly owners receive rent and reports. Ask for references from owners with homes similar to yours, too.
